TEST FIXTURE - NOT AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT
Training and Placement Policy 2025 (Fixture)
Issued by the Training and Placement Office. Version 1.0, effective 1 July 2025.

1. Purpose
This policy governs registration of final-year B.Tech students for campus placement.

3. Eligibility for Placement Registration
3.1 A student must have a minimum CGPA of 6.5 at the time of registration for placement.
3.2 A student must have no active backlogs at the time of registration for placement.
3.3 A student who has been placed in a dream company may not apply to further companies.

4. Registration Procedure
4.1 Eligible students register on the placement portal before 31 July each year and upload their resume.
4.2 Students must attend the pre-placement talk of each company they apply to.
